source: Marswalk app, public/data/team-inputs.default.json (branch hackathon/marswalk-simple-front, commit d2ed7bb0)
scienceGoal: Test if the difference between ridge rock and hollow rock holds across several ridge and hollow pairs in the walk area.

base.label: Crew rover, parked at the Curiosity position of sol 4534
base.originNote: A parked pressurized crew rover is an assumption of the Marswalk team; the position is the Curiosity waypoint of sol 4534 (NASA/JPL MMGIS MSL waypoints).

stops.reliefNote: height above (+) or below (-) the mean of a 31 m box, from the 1 m terrain
stops.task: Break a fresh face on the ridge rock with a hammer. Compare the inside with the weathered surface through a hand lens and bag the chip.
stops.short: Break ridge rock, compare, bag chip
stops.originNote: Stop position and task chosen by the Marswalk team; no published source. Relief derived from the USGS 1 m terrain.

stops.reliefNote: height above (+) or below (-) the mean of a 31 m box, from the 1 m terrain
stops.task: Dig a trench 20 cm deep in the hollow floor. Photograph the wall of the trench and bag material from the top and from the bottom.
stops.originNote: Stop position and task chosen by the Marswalk team; no published source. Relief derived from the USGS 1 m terrain.

stops.reliefNote: height above (+) or below (-) the mean of a 31 m box, from the 1 m terrain
stops.task: Measure the direction and the tilt of the ridge wall at three points with a compass clinometer, and mark each point on the map.

stops.reliefNote: height above (+) or below (-) the mean of a 31 m box, from the 1 m terrain
stops.task: Trace one light vein by hand from the ridge wall into the hollow floor. Sample both ends and record the length walked.

stops.reliefNote: height above (+) or below (-) the mean of a 31 m box, from the 1 m terrain
stops.task: Pick the three nodules that look most different inside a circle of 5 m, by eye. Bag them and photograph each place before removal.

stops.originNote: Stop position and task chosen by the Marswalk team; no published source. Relief derived from the USGS 1 m terrain.

stops.reliefNote: height above (+) or below (-) the mean of a 31 m box, from the 1 m terrain
